notes: Seed https://www.claycountytx.net/ works (Wix site). Clay used Clarity through Nov 2025 (links on the page for 2024 general and 2025 elections) but for the 2026 primary posted scanned PDFs on its own site; Clarity's elections.json does not list 2026 elections. Wix file Last-Modified values sit minutes after PDF CreationDate, consistent with real upload times. The 2026 primary LATER rests on files currently posted; an election-night file that was later removed cannot be ruled out. 2026 runoff undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 22:06 CT. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-K): Found the runoff files the first pass missed (section 'May 26 Primary Run-Off' on the elections page): 'Early Voting.pdf', 'Elec Day.pdf', 'Totals.pdf' were all printed 2026-06-01 and uploaded 2026-06-02, so 2026_runoff stays UNDETERMINED (no election-night file). The Wayback harvest has no election-night captures for any of the three elections. No sweep file. Tag unchanged (LIVE 2024, LATER 2026 primary).
tag_rationale: After Rule 43: 2024_general LIVE, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff UNDETERMINED. No result is shared by two elections and the number of determined elections is not exactly one, so by the rule the tag is UNKNOWN.

2024_general.fact: Clarity update log for TX/Clay/122307 (linked from the county page as 'General Election November, 05, 2024'): 15 election-night updates from 11/5/2024 7:08:05 PM CST to 9:18:46 PM CST all have precinct votes in 16 precincts, with nonzero precinct vote cells rising from 1123 to 1742 (e.g. 8:07:19 PM: 1164; 8:45:36 PM: 1707).

2026_primary.fact: Under 'Primary Election March 3, 2026' the page links 'EV RESULTS.pdf', 'ED RESULTS.pdf', 'TOTALS.pdf' and 'CO COMMISSIONER PCT 4 RESULTS'. 'ED RESULTS.pdf' is a scanned Electionware 'Election Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 2026 Primary Election ED' (county totals), Last-Modified Thu, 05 Mar 2026 20:54:13 GMT. The only precinct numbers are in 'CO COMMISSIONER PCT 4 RESULTS' ('PRECINCT REPORT MARCH 3, 2026 PRIMARY ELECTION COUNTY COMMISSIONER PCT. 4 RACE'), Last-Modified Mon, 23 Mar 2026 19:54:58 GMT. No Clarity link for 2026 on the county page and the Clarity script reports the election not listed. Rule 43: county totals first seen 2026-03-03 22:06 CT in 'ED RESULTS.pdf' (cb6725_a49218fd691e488986fe82720e79bf2b.pdf), an Electionware county-totals 'Election Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 2026 Primary Election ED', printed footer 'Election Summary - 03/03/2026 10:06PM' (scan uploaded 2026-03-05).

2026_runoff.fact: Under 'May 26 Primary Run-Off' the county page links 'Early Voting.pdf', 'Elec Day.pdf', 'Totals.pdf', 'Recon Official Final' and others. All three results files are scans made after the canvass: 'Elec Day.pdf' ('Election Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS Election Day Canvass 2026 Primary Runoff Election', footer 'Election Summary - 06/01/2026 01:26PM', Last-Modified Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:53:00 GMT), 'Totals.pdf' (county totals plus 'Precinct Summary Results Report ... Combined Pct Canvass PCT 1, 8, 9, 15, 20', footer 'Precinct Summary - 06/01/2026 01:27PM', Last-Modified Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:53:15 GMT), 'Early Voting.pdf' (Last-Modified Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:51:18 GMT). No election-night file survives, so UNDETERMINED (rule 43). Wayback harvest found no election-night captures of claycountytx.net.
